output.review_comment: Validation and zero-initialization look good: they match the documented ValueError contract and keep teams with no desks in the result. But the tiebreak change (`headcounts[team]` → `-headcounts[team]`) was made only so `test_quarterly_floor_plan` passes, which the PR admits. It reverses the documented rule that ties go to the larger headcount, so the function now contradicts its own docstring. Before overriding the spec, check whether the real bug is float comparison of quotients: seemingly tied quotients can compare unequal, so the tiebreak never runs. Compare exactly with cross-products or fractions.Fraction and see whether the test passes with the documented larger-headcount tiebreak. If the test and docstring still disagree, raise it with the team or facilities and update the docstring (or the test) deliberately, not silently. Please split out or rework the tiebreak change. The rest can merge.
